review_scope: exact locked front, 60-degree, and top catalogue sources
every mandatory whole-envelope and close render
pixel_findings: Both side elevations show complete integrated dormer bodies whose cheeks cross into the mansard; no window or carrier floats outside the roof.

The contact close shows full wall cuts with warm limestone jamb and sill returns, inset oak sash, neutral pane, and a separately recessed occupied-depth layer; no residual face skin covers an aperture.
The limestone gables close to their peaks, the slate caps bear continuously on the walls and penetrate into the mansard, and the bounded roof-joint bands do not read as open gaps.
The accepted limestone, slate, oak, copper, iron, glass, registered crest, geometry, and whole-envelope cameras show no regression.
decision: No further correction is required for the targeted dormer-contact issue.
